latestVersion.verdictComment: **🔥 CATASTROPHE ACCELERATING: 21 critical + kernel regressions discovered post-launch.** Four separate sub-systems now failing: gateway (crash + respawn loop), Discord (silent death + offline), Codex (missing deps + timeout), runtime (harness detection broken). Upgrade path contaminated — v2026.5.19-beta.1 inherits all 2026.5.18 flaws plus new gateway death spiral.
